name: hiasenhof-platform
description: Öffentliche Website und geschützte Admin-App für Hiasen Hof am Thiersee.

scripts.local: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p = Start-Process node -ArgumentList 'server.js' -PassThru; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Start-Process 'http://localhost:3001/index.html'; Wait-Process -Id $p.Id"
